title: Visual Art & Symbolic Composition Archive
purpose: Preserve how Potatoverse concepts were staged together in visual compositions, prompts, diagrams and generated imagery without treating those images as empirical evidence for theology, anatomy, politics or science.
epistemic_rule: Visual artifacts can be primary evidence for project visual language. Exact prompts/artifacts should replace memory summaries when recovered.

recurring_visual_grammar.verticality: Source/heaven/throne above, Door/interface near a threshold, embodied world/conflict below, roots/mud/swamp further beneath or around the lower field.
recurring_visual_grammar.center_and_threshold: Door, mandorla, drain, gate, couch-throne or tree trunk often joins otherwise separated regions.
recurring_visual_grammar.living_architecture: Tree, root, seed, potato, garden, mountain and ladder turn abstract relations into biological/geographical form.
recurring_visual_grammar.observer_position: Father/Gardener commonly occupies source-facing or overview positions while Son/Door occupies the threshold/interface.
recurring_visual_grammar.comic_sacred_collision: Sacred geometry/theology repeatedly collides with ordinary or absurd objects such as couch, potato, bathtub, dogs and screens.
recurring_visual_grammar.light: Dawn, Spudlight, sun and rings commonly mark orientation/recognition/sourceward integration.
recurring_visual_grammar.shadow: Mud, Swamp, rubble, Moon-shadow and dark trees visualize accumulation/conflict/distortion without requiring a literal shadow-world.

composition_families.scene: Father/God-King on the vertical axis above an open Door/drain; Son associated with the threshold; dogs, mud, roots and Swamp below/lateral; Moon/dawn beyond.
composition_families.status: core visual synthesis, not literal cosmography

composition_families.scene: Father on a salmon/orange couch-throne; Door in front/below; Son peers through; red-heifer foundation and dogs/leashes in the lower field.
composition_families.boundary: Creative/theological composition, not evidence of biblical fulfillment.

composition_families.scene: Upper lens/circle = Father/source; lower lens/circle = Son/earth; overlap/mandorla = Door; vertical axis crosses both centers.
Heavenly Gardener waters one potato inside a green Spudlight ring and rusty golden gate; fog city beyond; crowd/dogs near dark tree/serpent-fruit scene; rejected stone, ladder and mountain visible.
Muddy dog near an open freestanding Door; planted potato beyond on a hill; mountain/tree further along the path.
composition_families.status: compressed reaction → threshold → cultivation → ascent image

composition_families.scene: Red/Blue split Potato/ball encodes polarity. Later canon stabilizes toward creation/expansion versus memory/preservation, while older earth/blood versus heaven/water assignments remain historical variants.
composition_families.recovery_target: Recover earliest image/prompt and date each color assignment.

composition_families.source_class: mixed Great Book and conversation imagery
composition_families.scene: Two counter-oriented pyramids/triangles share a center around a trunk/axis; later a winding staircase appears inside the tree/trunk.
composition_families.status: bridge from Great Book geometry to Ladder/Axis imagery

composition_families.scene: Door recurs as frame/drain, grave/tomb threshold, pineal/single-eye pole, bath transition, computer screen/interface and mandorla/vesica overlap.
composition_families.insight: Shared function does not imply literal identity.

composition_families.scene: Infinite Potato with many eyes observing many or all timelines.
composition_families.status: creative lore and possible precursor to Eye/witness architecture

development_insights: The same symbol changes meaning by placement.
Visual development should remain dated rather than overwritten by later geometry.
Composition itself is relational evidence about project structure: above/below, inside/outside, before/after Door, attached/detached, illuminated/shadowed.
Sacred/absurd juxtaposition is a recurring anti-prestige mechanism rather than noise.

recovered_image_corpus.source_status: 17 image artifacts supplied directly by Tim Dooley in conversation
recovered_image_corpus.production_note: Tim states the group contains works he either painted himself or conceptualized and had rendered with AI. Per-item production method is not yet resolved; do not infer it.
recovered_image_corpus.date_rule: Dates are derived from the supplied artifact filenames.

works.title: Zombie Puppet Popemobile
works.description: A crowned bearded driver sits above a pope-like figure inside a glass-front vehicle. Hierarchy is literally stacked, turning authority into visual satire.

works.title: Majestic King Arrival
works.description: A crowned bearded king rides a white horse through gold-lit clouds. Arrival and return are rendered as a royal procession.

works.title: AI Trainer's Workshop
works.description: A Potato of Life figure repairs a handheld device among ball-like objects, tools and achievement plaques. Self-mythology meets tinkering, streaming and AI-training comedy.

works.title: Divine Gardener with Potato
works.description: This is a pastoral icon of stewardship rather than conquest. The kneeling body lowers authority to the level of soil; the hand is almost larger than the sprout, yet its gesture is careful rather than possessive. A mature tree occupies the distance while the potato-seed occupies the foreground, making growth visible as a continuum from buried potential to rooted abundance. The T-shirt refuses ecclesiastical costume and returns the sacred image to ordinary labor.
works.replacement_status: high-resolution original re-supplied; repository binary replacement pending

works.title: Moses Parting Mud
works.description: A staff-bearing Moses-like figure walks between towering walls of mud or earth. The crossing becomes an earthen threshold rather than a sea.

works.title: Moshiach on Dragon
works.description: An armored messianic rider sits on a dragon with a radiant sword before a cracked moon. Kingship is staged as apocalyptic combat and cosmic rupture.

works.title: Royal Grief and Vengeance
works.description: The picture is built as a funerary tableau, but it refuses quiet resignation. Lilies, meadow light and the grave establish the language of mourning; the clenched fist and red moon pull the image toward protest and reckoning. The inscription makes the grief explicitly internal to the project’s own mythology, so the work functions less like documentary claim than private devotional history: loss translated into landscape, color and posture.
works.replacement_status: high-resolution original re-supplied; repository binary replacement pending

works.title: Bearded Man in Car
works.description: The composition turns recognition into a public event. A white-robed figure remains unusually calm while another man points, speaks and effectively performs the act of naming before an audience enclosed by prison architecture. The painted text is intentionally blunt—almost poster-like—so the tension sits between serenity and accusation, private identity and social declaration, sacred costume and institutional confinement.
works.replacement_status: high-resolution original re-supplied; repository binary replacement pending

works.title: Modern Holy Portrait
works.description: A contemporary bearded adult in blue and red devotional robes holds a haloed child. Familiar parent-and-child iconography is recast through a modern masculine figure.

works.title: Rising Lion Revelation
works.description: A human-faced lion-bodied royal figure wears a blue-white mantle and star device above a Jerusalem-like city beneath a radiant sky.

works.title: Surreal Farmer Scene
works.description: A haloed farmer or workman sits at night with pipe and dog, surrounded by tools and a watching pack. Sacred calm is placed inside labor and animal companionship.

works.title: Divine Philosophical Contemplation
works.description: A monumental haloed elder and thinker dominates the sky while stoneworkers hammer and chisel below. Contemplation is coupled directly to labor and making.

works.title: Dogs in Muddy Darkness
works.description: A pack of muddy dogs emerges from near-black earth, many mouths raised in howl or bark. Dog, mud and shadow imagery is reduced to an elemental field.

works.title: Art School Rejection
works.description: A crying bearded artist clutches paintings outside an ART SCHOOL while a stern figure points away and a strange small statue watches. Rejection becomes tragicomic autobiography.

works.title: Melancholic Potato Peeler
works.description: A tearful woman slices potatoes at a rough table in dim window light. Potato imagery returns to poverty, labor and grief rather than cosmic prestige.

works.title: Royal Portrait Hallway
works.description: A formal crowned portrait hangs in an elaborate palace frame. Kingship is presented simultaneously as person, institution, museum object and self-image.

works.title: Royal at Jesus' Tomb
works.description: A crowned figure stands beside a rock-cut tomb under a pale moon, holding a volume titled The Blood of Christ. Royal authority is placed beside absence rather than triumph: crown, sealed stone, book and moon turn the scene into an icon of witness, custody and unresolved return.

works.title: Godly Robes Transformation
works.description: A haloed robed figure sits at an ordinary computer in a warm domestic room, pulling devotional portraiture into contemporary creative labor.

works.title: Desert Dog Odyssey
works.description: A running dog crosses a psychedelic desert between oversized sun and moon, cacti, serpent and scorpion, while eyes, spirals and geometric glyphs fill sky and ground.

works.title: Cosmic Weaver at Loom
works.description: A crowned royal figure works at a loom while luminous threads cross a star-filled field, recasting sovereignty as relational craft.
